messages:
Sam: kicking off canary for awq-llama-70b build (awq-prod-2026-03-18). seeing intermittent decode errors and token drops, starts ~5m after deploy. deployment id canary-2026-03-18-19
Maya: what do the logs show? any stack traces?
Sam: paste logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T19:02:11Z] ERROR decoder: token drop at step=24 logits shape mismatch
[2026-03-18T19:02:11Z] WARN kvcache: expected_len=256 got=512
[2026-03-18T19:02:11Z] ERROR stream: connection reset during generation (frame=3)
[2026-03-18T19:02:12Z] INFO runner: model=awq group_size=32 act_q=8 batch=4
```
Jin: do we have a numeric failure rate vs baseline?
Sam: yes — baseline FP16 canary fail rate ~0.02% over 100k reqs. AWQ canary (g32, act8) fail rate ~0.9% over ~12k reqs. p95 latency +18ms.
Arjun: group_size 32 + per-group activation quant can cause outliers if activations spike. try group_size=8 and act_q_bits=6 for a quick sanity check. also suspect interaction with KV caching.
Maya: agree — try toggling KV cache off for the AWQ canary env: `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=false` and re-evaluate.
Noah: FYI last quarter we saw similar oscillation when group_size mismatch exposed a quant rounding path. revert to FP16 always fixes it, but we'd like to avoid rollback. do A/B.
Sam: started two parallel canaries: `awq-g8-act6` and `awq-g32-act8-kvoff`. commands used:
```
# canary A
deploy --slot canary --model awq-llama-70b --env REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=true --config group_size=8 act_q_bits=6 label=awq-g8-act6
# canary B
deploy --slot canary --model awq-llama-70b --env REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=false --config group_size=32 act_q_bits=8 label=awq-g32-act8-kvoff
```
ops-bot: canary awq-g8-act6 deployed -> healthy :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: canary awq-g32-act8-kvoff deployed -> degraded :warning:
Sam: quick metrics after 10k requests:
- awq-g8-act6: fail_rate=0.035% p95_lat= +12ms
- awq-g32-act8-kvoff: fail_rate=0.82% p95_lat= +17ms
Maya: big delta. group_size reduction helped a lot. next: run token-delta evals (LAMBADA, PIQA, HellaSwag) to check quality regressions.
Jin: also capture per-token logprobs for mismatches and run a small diff against FP16 reference to see if errors are systematic.
Sam: running evals now, starting with 5k LAMBADA pass. will post results here.
Arjun: if g8+act6 stabilizes but costs more, consider hybrid route: keep g8 for attention-heavy prefixes and g32 for steady-state decoding, or try 6-bit symmetric vs asymmetric act quant to reduce rounding bias.
Noah: +1 to mixed profile. also consider increasing model batch target to smooth quant effects (batching=8 vs 4).
Sam: preliminary eval result (5k LAMBADA): awq-g8-act6 exact-match delta vs FP16 = -0.6% (within tolerance), awq-g32-act8-kvoff = -4.2% (regression).
Maya: that's a clear quality signal. please log these results in the bakeoff sheet and tag `#evals`.
Sam: done, sheet link: https://docs.redwood/reports/awq-bakeoff-2026-03-18 (added rows for p95/p99/fail-rate/token-delta)
Jin: next steps I recommend: 1) keep awq-g8-act6 canary for 24h and collect 200k requests, 2) run full eval suite (20k tokens) overnight, 3) profile hot kernels with `nvprof` to see perf hit.
Sam: agreeing. I'll extend the canary window and start profiler run. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maya: noted — tag me if we want a rollback plan doc.
Arjun: captures made, will try a kernel-level patch to reduce act quant clipping and report back.
Sam: closing loop later today with final numbers. :eyes:
